newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S.A.S. Dragon places 8.0 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: S.A.S. Dragon places 8.0 mln new shares.

text.p: Electronic components and fashion distributor S.A.S. Dragon Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to place 8.0 million new shares, or 2.87 percent of expanded share capital, at HK$0.80 per share.
The company said net proceeds of about HK$6.2 million would be used for general working capital.
China Everbright Securities (HK) Ltd is the placing agent.
On completion of the placing on September 26, will dilute the stake of the company's controlling shareholder, Unimicro Ltd, to 35.1 percent from 36.2 percent.
Unimicro is beneficially owned by Stanley Yim, S.A.S. Dragon's chairman and managing director.
S.A.S. Dragon shares ended at HK$0.80 on Friday, down one cent. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
